rules.summary: Awaken for 5 AXP (1st slot) once the PC has 500 XP; each further slot costs 5 AXP, up to 10. A power of Tier N fills N slots. Only one Tier 4+ power at a time. Remove powers once a year; fill empty slots between events with 3 days notice.

powers.name: Basic Skill Use
powers.summary: Use a chosen Basic skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Basic Unstable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Basic unstable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Read and Write a Language
powers.summary: Read and write a chosen rulebook language.

powers.name: Race or Group Friend
powers.summary: Marks you as a friend of a race or group (GM approval).

powers.name: Longer Death Count
powers.summary: Death count lasts 1 minute longer.

powers.name: Ritual Base Magic
powers.summary: Count as having a chosen Base Magic skill you lack when casting a Ritual.

powers.name: Store Basic Performance
powers.summary: Store a Basic Performance performed into the Artifact until used.

powers.name: Perform Basic Performance
powers.summary: Perform a chosen Basic Performance once per re-pop.

powers.name: Store Basic Skill Use
powers.summary: Store one Basic skill use cast on the Artifact until the wielder uses it.

powers.name: Hasten Basic Healing
powers.summary: The wielder's Basic Healing action is Hastened.

powers.name: Hasten Refits on Wielder
powers.summary: All armor refits done on the wielder are Hastened.

powers.name: Locate Artifact
powers.summary: Sense direction and rough distance to the Artifact after 10 seconds of focus.

powers.name: Conjured Gear
powers.summary: On a 10-count conjure an unstable weapon, shield, or Relic (your own legal phys rep; Enhancement Slot effect). It vanishes if it leaves you.

powers.name: Whispering Wind
powers.summary: Cast Whispering Wind or Amplify Whispering Wind (1 minute two-way talk or a 50-word message) once per re-pop.

powers.name: Extra Enhancement Slot
powers.summary: Once per re-pop, gain one extra Enhancement Slot.

powers.name: Detect Lie
powers.summary: Detect Lie, once each re-pop.

powers.name: Touch to Packet
powers.summary: Change an ability's range from Touch to Packet once per re-pop.

powers.name: Extra Divination Witness
powers.summary: One more person may witness your Divinations.

powers.name: Living Artifact or Familiar
powers.summary: The Artifact becomes a living creature, or your Familiar becomes your Artifact (fills both roles with both sets of powers).

powers.name: Condition Immunity (once per event)
powers.summary: Immunity to a chosen allowed condition for the encounter, once per event.

powers.name: 20 Armor Points
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: +20 Armor Points on self, held in an Enhancement Slot.

powers.name: 20 Life Points
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: +20 Life Points on self, held in an Enhancement Slot.

powers.name: Elemental Relic
powers.summary: The Artifact works as a Relic of a chosen element.

powers.name: Basic Skill at Expert
powers.summary: Use a chosen Basic non-crafting skill with its Expert Technique once per re-pop.

powers.name: Advanced Magic at Basic
powers.summary: Use a chosen Advanced magic skill at Basic once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Expert Unstable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Expert unstable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Suit of Armor
powers.summary: The Artifact counts as a suit of armor covering four locations (no other locations may be added).

powers.name: Frontal Cone
powers.summary: Make a damaging ability Frontal Cone once per re-pop.

powers.name: Self Portal
powers.summary: Open a self-only Portal to a chosen location once per re-pop.

powers.name: Transfer Status Effects
powers.summary: Move all status effects from one target onto yourself once per re-pop.

powers.name: Transfer Life Points
powers.summary: Give your Life Points to another in 5-point steps as Healing (excess becomes Temporary Life) once per re-pop.

powers.name: Longer Bleed-Out Timer
powers.summary: Bleed-out timer lasts 1 minute longer.

powers.name: Store Expert Performance
powers.summary: Store an Expert Performance performed into the Artifact until used.

powers.name: Perform Expert Performance
powers.summary: Perform a chosen Expert Performance (no frequency stated).

powers.name: Store Expert Skill Use
powers.summary: Store one Expert skill use cast on the Artifact until the wielder uses it.

powers.name: Hasten Refits by Wielder
powers.summary: All armor refits done by the wielder are Hastened.

powers.name: Summon Artifact
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: a 10-count calls the Artifact to your hand.

powers.name: Meld Artifact
powers.summary: A 30-count merges the Artifact into your body or brings it back out; it is not adorned while merged.

powers.name: Renew Magic Item
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: a 100-count restores one use of a magic item.

powers.name: Renew Familiar Power
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: a 100-count restores one Familiar power.

powers.name: Condition Immunity (once per re-pop)
powers.summary: Immunity to a chosen allowed condition for the encounter, once per re-pop.

powers.name: Quick Refit
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: refit your own armor with a 3-count.

powers.name: Short Claws
powers.summary: Grow a pair of Short Claws, base 2 damage.

powers.name: +1 Passive Weapon Damage
powers.summary: +1 Passive Weapon Damage.

powers.name: +1 Passive Relic Damage
powers.summary: +1 Passive Relic Damage.

powers.name: Basic Skill at Master
powers.summary: Use a chosen Basic non-crafting skill with its Master Technique once per re-pop.

powers.name: Advanced Magic at Expert
powers.summary: Use a chosen Advanced magic skill with its Expert Technique once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Master Unstable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Master unstable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Basic Stable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Basic stable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Group Enhancement
powers.summary: Make an Enhancement Slot ability affect a group once per re-pop.

powers.name: Amplified Life Slot
powers.summary: One extra Enhancement Slot of the Amplified Life kind.

powers.name: Amplified Armor Slot
powers.summary: One extra Enhancement Slot of the Amplified Armor kind.

powers.name: Lash
powers.summary: Make a damaging ability Lash once per re-pop.

powers.name: One-Minute Portal
powers.summary: Open a 1-minute Portal to a chosen location once per re-pop.

powers.name: Amplify Healing
powers.summary: Amplify all Healing on you.

powers.name: Hasten Counted Actions
powers.summary: The Artifact assists your counted actions, Hastening them.

powers.name: Permanent Condition Immunity
powers.summary: Permanent immunity to a chosen allowed condition. Only one of this power.

powers.name: Attune Person or Item
powers.summary: On a 100-count attune a willing person or person-sized item; summon them on a 3-count once per re-pop (may fail if they are far away).

powers.name: Packet to Point
powers.summary: Change an ability's range from Packet to Point (up to three packets) once per re-pop.

powers.name: Basic Skill at Grandmaster
powers.summary: Use a chosen Basic non-crafting skill with its Grandmaster Technique once per re-pop.

powers.name: Advanced Magic at Master
powers.summary: Use a chosen Advanced magic skill with its Master Technique once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Grandmaster Unstable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Grandmaster unstable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Expert Stable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Expert stable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Self-Centered Lash
powers.summary: Make an Enhancement Slot ability or spell a Lash centered on you once per re-pop.

powers.name: Voice Radius Damage
powers.summary: Make a damaging ability Voice Radius once per re-pop.

powers.name: Rift to the Tavern
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: a 3-count Rift takes you to the tavern.

powers.name: Protection
powers.summary: Declare a target under your protection: Reduced damage from damaging effects for the encounter while within 5 feet of you, once per re-pop.

powers.name: Shorter Status Effects
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: shorten every status effect duration for the encounter.

powers.name: Artifact Do-Over
powers.summary: Call "Artifact Do-Over" to redo something from the last 10 seconds (non-combat intent, GM has final say) once per re-pop.

powers.name: Advanced Magic at Grandmaster
powers.summary: Use a chosen Advanced magic skill with its Grandmaster Technique once per re-pop.

powers.name: Craft Master Stable Item
powers.summary: Create a chosen Master stable crafted consumable from a starting crafting skill once per re-pop.

powers.name: Voice Radius Enhancement
powers.summary: Make an Enhancement Slot ability Voice Radius once per re-pop.

powers.name: Group Rift to the Tavern
powers.summary: Once per re-pop: a 3-count Rift takes you and everyone touching you to the tavern.

powers.name: Reduce All Damage
powers.summary: Take Reduced damage from everything for the encounter, once per event.

powers.name: Delay Death
powers.summary: Delay all status and death effects until the encounter ends, once per event. A delayed death makes you a Manifested Spirit at once and costs 2 Spirit Fragments; a Spirit Puzzle can win one back.

powers.name: Phoenix Rising
powers.summary: Cast Phoenix Rising on a spirit: they return at full Life and do not lose a Spirit Fragment, once per event.
